snippet.title: Whiskerwood - Official Early Access Launch Trailer
snippet.description: Whiskerwood is available now in Early Access via Steam, GOG, Epic Games Store, and the Microsoft Store, as well as PC Game Pass (Game Preview). Watch the Whiskerwood Early Access launch trailer for this cat-and-mouse city builder game. Carve mountains, traverse seas, and explore untamed new lands as you build grand cities – the ingenuity of the humble mouse is on full display in Whiskerwood as you establish elaborate automation systems to efficiently run complex production chains, all while dealing with the oppressive demands of your cat overlords.
